# Contributing

Thanks for taking the time to contribute! This list is meant to be a community-driven resource for self-hosted AI agent tools.

## Guidelines

- Search previous suggestions before making a new one to avoid duplicates.
- Make an individual pull request for each suggestion.
- Use the following format: `- [Tool Name](url) - Description.`
- Descriptions should be concise, clear, and factual. No marketing language.
- New categories or improvements to the existing categorization are welcome.
- Check your spelling and grammar.
- The pull request and commit should have a useful title.
- The tool must be open source and self-hostable.

## Quality Standards

- The tool should be actively maintained (commits within the last 12 months).
- It should have documentation sufficient for self-hosting.
- It should be relevant to running AI agents in a self-hosted environment.

## Updating Your Pull Request

If the maintainers notice anything that needs to be changed, we will ask you to edit your PR before merging. If you are not sure how to do that, [here is a guide](https://github.com/RichardLitt/knowledge/blob/master/github/amending-a-commit-guide.md) on updating a pull request.
